instruction: Create a service template instantiated multiple times.
output:
# worker@.service
[Unit]
Description=Worker instance %i

[Service]
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/worker --id %i
# Start instances:
systemctl enable --now worker@1.service worker@2.service

instruction: Use specifiers in a unit file.
output:
[Service]
# %n = unit name, %i = instance, %h = home, %t = runtime dir
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/app --name %n --dir %t/%n
RuntimeDirectory=%n

instruction: Add a health check using a watchdog.
output:
[Service]
Type=notify
WatchdogSec=30
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/app
# The app must send WATCHDOG=1 via sd_notify regularly.

instruction: Use systemd-run to run an ad-hoc transient service.
Run a one-off command with resource limits via systemd-run.
Schedule a transient timer at a specific time.
Blueprint a service with sandboxing and resource controls.
output:
[Service]
DynamicUser=yes
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
StateDirectory=svc
MemoryMax=512M
CPUQuota=80%
IOWeight=50
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/svc

instruction: Apply cgroup resource limits with slices.
output:
# app.slice
[Slice]
MemoryMax=2G
CPUQuota=200%

# service drop-in adds Slice=app.slice
[Service]
Slice=app.slice
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/app

instruction: Use StateDirectory and CacheDirectory for automatic paths.
Import credentials securely with LoadCredentialEncrypted.
Reload a service atomically via sd_notify with Type=notify-reload.
Chain services with an OnSuccess/OnFailure handler.
Use Requires + BindsTo for a tightly coupled sidecar.
Apply a drop-in override without editing the packaged unit.
output:
# /etc/systemd/system/app.service.d/override.conf
[Service]
Environment=EXTRA=1
LimitNOFILE=65535
# then: systemctl daemon-reload && systemctl restart app.service

instruction: Set a high file descriptor limit for a network service.
Run a service in its own network namespace with a tun device.
Use OOMScoreAdjust and allow killing the service under pressure.
output:
[Service]
OOMScoreAdjust=-500
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/critical
# Negative values make it LESS likely to be OOM-killed.

instruction: Delay activation until a specific device exists.
Define a service with multiple ExecStart lines (only valid for Type=oneshot).
Audit and harden a unit using systemd tooling.
output:
systemd-analyze security app.service
systemd-analyze verify /etc/systemd/system/app.service
# Use the score report to add missing hardening directives.
